historical_scope: The trusted delivery exercised the 20210528 API. Address relocation, newer API compatibility and general DWARF conformance were not qualified. The GNU ELF fixture is an explicit host prerequisite.
scope: The fixed 20210528 producer/consumer API, a bounded DWARF4 round trip, independent GNU reading and damaged/missing-DIE examples; two exact DEB inputs and the complete corresponding dwarfutils source set. The example intentionally does not generate address references.
